title: Finite-N Kuramoto Synchronization
abstract: Formalizes the finite-N Kuramoto model of coupled phase oscillators: the order parameter and its unit bound, the potential/force gradient identities, smoothness and local Lipschitz continuity of the vector field with ODE existence and uniqueness, Lyapunov descent along trajectories, pairwise and semicircle contraction estimates, Hebbian phase/weight dynamics, and full convergence to synchrony under all-to-all coupling from initial phases in an open semicircle.

informal.kuramotoR_norm_le_one: The Kuramoto order parameter has norm at most one for any phase configuration.
informal.weighted_lyapunov_descent: The weighted Kuramoto potential is non-increasing along the gradient flow, since the sum of force times potential-derivative over all oscillators is at most zero.
informal.allToAll_convergence_to_synchrony: Under all-to-all coupling with positive strength and initial phases in an open semicircle, the order parameter norm tends to one, i.e. the oscillators synchronize.
